title: H3 windowed refine: status bar climbs 2/2 -> 3/3 -> 4/4
description: MpiWindowedSampler builds a fresh progress bar per window (latent_preview.prepare_callback inside the window loop), so a windowed H3 stage 2 emits one bar per window. progressStages records stage2 = 1 bar, and phaseProgress self-corrects the total upward each window: a 20 s 1K run (3 windows) read 2/2, 3/3, 4/4 - the user reads each as the last step. Fix at the source: one progress bar across all windows (steps x windows), so stage 2 is always one stage and its % covers the whole refine. Ships as MpiNodes commit -> push -> pin in dev_configs/node_lock.json.
